summary: TOYO Co., Ltd, a Cayman-incorporated, Tokyo-based Nasdaq-listed solar manufacturer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 28, 2026, carrying two press releases: a second-half 2026 business outlook and disclosure of approximately $240 million in binding U.S. solar module supply agreements through the first half of 2027. No transaction, stake, price, or board recommendation appears. The filing flags regulatory uncertainty from a pending CBP examination, countervailing duty activity, and the Section 232 polysilicon program, while affirming confidence in positive H2 2026 EBITDA. It is a routine operational update, not a special situation; watch policy outcomes and order conversion.
